t: A classic Eurorack sound module with 24 ways to make tones and drums.
steps: Buy a µPlaits SE clone from Tall Dog or find a used original on a gear marketplace.
Set up a powered Eurorack case with a few patch cables.
Plug in the ribbon power cable with the red stripe in the right spot.
Patch the OUT jack to a mixer, speaker, or headphone module.
Send a gate into TRIG and turn the frequency knob to hear a note.
Press the model buttons to step through the sounds.
Check for firmware v1.2 and play the update sound file into it to add the newer models.
meta: Wild Open. From $225. A few stores.
